C1160.title: Amazon Fined €746 Million for GDPR Violations
C1160.summary: In 2021, Luxembourg's data protection authority CNPD issued a GDPR administrative decision against Amazon Europe Core S.à r.l., imposing a €746 million fine, a landmark high-value penalty in GDPR enforcement. After Amazon appealed, Luxembourg's Administrative Tribunal rejected the appeal in 2025 and upheld the CNPD decision, keeping both the fine and corrective measures in place, making the case a major enforcement example for personal-data compliance by large cross-border e-commerce platforms.
